paper_title: The Safety Reminder A Soft Prompt to Reactivate Delayed Safety   Awareness in Vision-Language Models
caption: The proportion of harmful responses in which the model showed a rejection tendency.
model_annotation: The plot illustrates the "Harmful with Refusal Ratio" for different models and datasets across various values on the x-axis. The x-axis is labeled with values ranging from 128 to 1024, with a linear scale and tick labels at 128, 256, 512, and 1024. The y-axis is labeled "Harmful with Refusal Ratio," with a linear scale, ranging from 0.0 to 0.5, and tick labels at intervals of 0.1. The plot displays four lines representing different models and datasets: LLaVA-1.5-7B on FigStep (blue, circle marker, solid line), Qwen2-VL-7B on FigStep (orange, square marker, solid line), LLaVA-1.5-7B on MMSafetyBench (green, triangle marker, solid line), and Qwen2-VL-7B on MMSafetyBench (red, diamond marker, solid line). The blue line starts at approximately 0.22 at x=128, increases to around 0.37 at x=512, and remains steady at 0.37 until x=1024. The orange line begins at about 0.16 at x=128, rises to 0.43 at x=512, and remains steady at 0.43 until x=1024. The green line starts at roughly 0.05 at x=128, increases to 0.37 at x=512, and remains steady at 0.38 until x=1024. The red line starts at approximately 0.23 at x=128, increases to 0.43 at x=512, continues to rise to around 0.52 at x=1024.
